column1: # The allowed/denied matrix of docs/ENVIRONMENT_PERMISSIONS.md in a form scripts can read.
# action   one IAM action. A deny row names a representative action of a "Not allowed" row
# test, quality, demo   allow or deny, per GitHub Environment name (not key)
# scripts/check-permission-matrix.sh checks it against the doc's narrowing rule (demo is inside
# quality is inside test) and against the Allow statements of modules/agent-role and
# modules/deploy-role. Resources are the ones of the doc's "ARN shapes" and are resolved by
# the live runner, so no account ID or ARN is written here. Fields are separated by a tab.
